.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (incl. Known false positives: sign-in/identity surface by house convention)
evidence: Runtime facts vs launcher (tests/test.sh:97-111,127-190): entry /app/server.js (instruction.md:7; integration.md:3), start = Node 22 as an ordinary user, cwd not /app, find files relative to server.js (integration.md:3; test.sh runs uid 65534 via setpriv, HOME=/tmp/submission), port 3000 on 0.0.0.0 (integration.md:3 = test.sh PORT=3000 = app_context URL), storage SQLite /app/app.db or DB_PATH (instruction.md:7; integration.md:3), injected env exactly PATH/NODE_PATH/HOME/PORT/DB_PATH named (integration.md:3 = test.sh:104-109), health GET /api/health 200 even if DB fails (integration.md:3 = probe_ready), fixed clock 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z (integration.md:7 = seed clock), seed /assets/seed_data.json imported once, no leftover DB (instruction.md:7; integration.md:5), no symlinks in /app (integration.md:5 vs test.sh:72-83 zero on symlink; brief is stricter than checker, safe), restart persistence of every graded item incl. walls, unread positions, versions (integration.md:5 vs persistence criterion + restart_mcp), accounts and password123 with roles and Dev's M-12 wall (walls-and-retention.md:3-15). Network public; external assets allowed (integration.md:3). Graded-vs-asked sweep of all 2 gate + 16 functional + 6 polish + 4 visual criteria found a public source for each graded observable: signed-out emptiness (instruction.md:7; integration.md:9), client scope and plain not-available (walls-and-retention.md:15-17), wall on every route incl. quotes/mentions/links/suggestions/transcript and live wall within ~10 s, partner-only wall control (w&r:17-19; conversations.md:21), cross-matter reply refusal (conv:5), nested replies >=3 deep in parent order with quote (conv:5), exact-age expiry boundary, edit not younger, shorten deletes now, off/lengthen never restores, versions go with message, deleted-parent placeholder (w&r:23-25; conv:9), hold scope/delete block/release immediate/typed 'On hold' not a mark (w&r:29; conv:13), staff earlier versions, stale edit refused with text kept, author-only edit/delete, confirm delete (conv:9), mention add/remove on edit/delete and @ suggestions limited to viewers (conv:21), safe formatting everywhere incl. snippets/versions/transcripts and http/https-only links in new tab (conv:13), copyable message link with preview/not-available and persistent highlight (conv:17), per-person unread consistent across tabs, new-messages line, mark unread, deleted not counted (conv:25), dedupe of re-sent message and stable same-time order across thread/search/transcript (conv:31), live updates within ~10 s keeping draft/scroll/open reply (conv:33), Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape (conv:29), case-insensitive literal substring search excluding versions and deleted text, click opens at message (w&r:33), transcript heading/order/threads/author/sent time/edited/hold/versions/no chat controls/visibility (w&r:35), refusal reason stays in place (w&r:37), 390 px no sideways scroll (conv:35, covers transcript_print and phone_chambers), timer setting beside title (w&r:23, covers retention_marks). Weak-app probe: an app that only loads but never shares/persists posts fails the constraints gate, which the brief requires anyway (instruction.md:3,9). Conforming-alternative probe: an app that reads seed from cwd or writes DB beside cwd would fail, but integration.md:3 explicitly says resolve relative to server.js and honour DB_PATH, so that failure is fairly forewarned. Only implicit item: a sign-out control is graded (functional signin_and_client_scope Part A 'Sign out'; polish refusal_in_place 'Sign out') but the brief only implies it via 'sign in as different people ... from the pages themselves' (instruction.md:9); the skill lists sign-in/identity surface by house convention as a known false positive, so recorded as an observation, not a defect. This is a source review only; no runtime evidence is required for this row and no Oracle/model score is claimed.
